name: share-ephemeral-artifact
job: Share a non-secret file or log via short-lived public URL with retention and ToS limits.

inScope: Choosing an L1 or L2 hobby host
Uploading via documented CLI or curl and capturing URL and retention
Verifying with one GET and stating size and content class
outOfScope: Tokens, private keys, customer PII, or env files
Using ephemeral hosts as release source of truth

inputs: Non-secret file, log, screenshot, or build output
outputs: Short-lived public URL with retention or expiry
Verified GET with content type and size
Explicit non-secret statement and provider reliability residual
failureSemantics: Public hosts are treated as hostile with crawlers assumed; no production custody or compliance archive is claimed; secrets never reach the artifact.

outcome.observable: A short-lived public URL serving the scrubbed artifact with recorded retention, a verified GET, an explicit non-secret statement, and the provider reliability residual stated.
